name: esp32_c6_supermini
title: ESP32-C6 Super Mini
description: A small ESP32-C6 board: 4 MB flash in the chip, USB-C to the chip, a blue LED and a WS2812, BOOT and RST buttons, a TP4054 charger for a cell on pads, a ceramic antenna
notes: Sold by many shops with no maker on the board; Super Mini ESP32-C6 on the back. The schematic read names no maker; Anton's board agrees with it on every pin tried.
GPIO 12 and 13 are the USB of the chip, also on holes inside the board.

usb.notes: The USB-C goes to the USB Serial/JTAG of the chip through 22 Ω, the console and the flashing. CC1 and CC2 have 5.1 kΩ to GND.

led.notes: Blue, to GND through 1 kΩ. GPIO 15 is a strapping pin.

rgb.notes: On 3V3. GPIO 8 is a strapping pin.

charger.notes: Charges a cell on BAT from VBUS. Its green LED on CHRG, BAT on the board, lights while it charges; no GPIO reaches it. With no cell on the pads it blinks in short flashes. PROG has 10 kΩ.

d_bat.notes: From BAT to VCC; the schematic names it PD2, as the blue LED.

reg_3v3.notes: An LDO from VCC to 3V3; the schematic gives no part number.

power.name: VBUS
power.why: VBUS of the USB-C, also contact 1 of H2 (5V on the board).

power.name: BAT
power.why: The pad B+ on the back; B- is GND.

battery.type: pads on the back, B+ and B-

front.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06

back.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06

pins.source: the schematic of the board, Altium, no maker named, as esp32-c6-supermini-board-schematic.pdf linked from mischianti.org/esp32-c6-supermini-high-resolution-pinout-datasheet-schema-and-specs/, fetched 2026-11-06

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06
photo.notes: The silkscreen: 5V GND 3V3 20 19 18 15 14 9 8 on one row, TX RX 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 on the other (16 and 17 on the back), holes 12 13 21 22 23, B+ and B- on the back.

bench.notes: With GPIO 15 high for 3 s and low for 1 s the blue LED is on for 3 s. The WS2812 sent red for 3 s, then green, blue and dark for 1 s each, shows red for 3 s: the usual order of colours.

chip.source: esptool on Anton's board: ESP32-C6FH4 (QFN32) rev 0.2, 4 MB flash in the chip

charger_led.notes: No cell on B+ and B-: the green LED blinks in short flashes all the time, whatever the program.

edges.source: the labels of the holes on front.webp and back.webp, the photos of both sides of Anton's board: on the front USB-C is on the left
